description: This file implements internal error handling for the UWP platform, including displaying error dialogs and managing error state for system platform errors related to the 'starboard' interface.

classes.name: SbSystemPlatformErrorPrivate
classes.description: A class managing the display and lifecycle of system platform error dialogs on UWP, including reference counting and callback invocation.

methods.name: SbSystemPlatformErrorPrivate
methods.description: Constructor that creates and shows an error dialog, manages error count, and sets up completion handler.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the dialog operation is still valid (not canceled or completed).

methods.name: ClearAndDelete
methods.description: Cancels the dialog if valid and deletes the object.

methods.name: MakeUICommand
methods.description: Creates a UICommand with a label and an invoked handler that calls the provided callback.
